$comment: Machine readable architecture policy. Enforced by harness/guard/archcheck (Go) and harness/guard/fsd.ts (web). Part of the Repository Harness: see harness/quality/README.md.

services.$comment: One declaration for every service: each directory under dir with a go.mod gets the same layers. Layers are listed innermost first. A package may import its own layer and any layer listed before it, never one listed after it. pkg/app is the composition root and the only public package; cmd only parses the environment and runs it.

web.$comment: Feature-Sliced Design. Layers are listed lowest first. A module may import lower layers only, must reach other slices through their public API (index.ts), and must not import a sibling slice of its own layer.
